text:
connie (sales): Emily is on the demo call. Their script gets 403 on /v1/generate. Customer waiting, can we triage fast?

ravi (sales-eng): Hi Emily, can you paste the curl and full error body? 403 usually header vs token binding.

emily (customer): curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SK_DEMO_42" -H "X-Org-Id: corp-88" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/generate -d '{"prompt":"short summary"}'
Error: {"error":"access_denied","detail":"token bound to corp-17"}

igor (platform): token-bot, inspect SK_DEMO_42 please.

token-bot: inspect: SK_DEMO_42 -> bound_org: corp-17, scopes: [generate], created_via: sales-quickstart

ravi (sales-eng): Token is bound to corp-17. If you send X-Org-Id corp-88 we return 403. Two quick fixes: remove X-Org-Id or use a token bound to corp-88. Which is easiest for demo?

emily (customer): Our demo harness sets X-Org-Id automatically. Removing it might break our multi-tenant flow. Can you mint a demo key for corp-88?

igor (platform): I can mint a short-lived key now. token-bot: issue temp key EK_88_DEMO scope=generate bound_org=corp-88 expires_in=3600
token-bot: issued: EK_88_DEMO (generate) bound_org=corp-88 expires_in=3600s

emily (customer): EK_88_DEMO works, demo resumes. Thank you!

connie (sales): Nice. Emily, procurement also asked for a security contact and a brief pricing note. I'll send those after the call.

legal-bot: SOC2 and data handling docs: https://redwood.ai/soc2. Reach legal@redwood.ai for questionnaires.

ravi (sales-eng): Follow-ups for us: 1) offer permanent key for corp-88 if they proceed, 2) add a short troubleshooting blurb to the POC checklist about X-Org vs token binding, 3) consider including bound_org in 403 payload (mask token id) to speed triage.

igor (platform): Logged INF-580: add bound_org hint to error responses (security-approved). Also will add quick fix to docs.

emily (customer): Appreciate the speedy help. Will review pricing and security docs.

connie (sales): Closing thread, will attach keys and docs in the CRM ticket. Great teamwork :thumbsup:
